title: Painted corner cubes
observableEvidence: Identifies that every small cube in a 2-by-2-by-2 cube is a corner cube with three painted faces after exterior painting.
prompt: Eight unit cubes are arranged to make a 2 by 2 by 2 cube. The outside of the large cube is painted, and then the unit cubes are separated. How many unit cubes have exactly three painted faces?

figure.caption: A 2 by 2 by 2 cube built from eight unit cubes.

solutionRepresentation: In a 2 by 2 by 2 cube, every unit cube is at a corner of the large cube. A corner cube has exactly three outside faces, so all 8 unit cubes have exactly three painted faces.
solutionMethod: Classify the unit cubes by position: a 2-by-2-by-2 cube has no interior or edge-only cubes, only corners.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept 8 with or without the word cubes.

hintSteps.prompt: Classify each small cube by its position in the large cube.
hintSteps.question: Does a 2-by-2-by-2 cube have any unit cubes that are not on a corner?

hintSteps.prompt: A corner unit cube touches the outside on three perpendicular faces.
hintSteps.question: How many painted faces does each corner unit cube receive?

hintSteps.prompt: A tiny cube at a corner of a painted box shows paint on the three faces meeting at that corner.
hintSteps.question: How many unit cubes in this arrangement are corner cubes?
